capture.action: Town loaded; exact-boundary capture for original reward, progression, EXP, gold, material and monster lifecycle methods; no managed object values read

payload.source: IL2CPP exported reflection API and MethodInfo pointer prefix

limitations: MethodInfo pointer fields are version-sensitive; both leading candidates are retained.
Without --exact-boundaries, a bounded native prefix may not contain every branch or inlined dependency.
Disassembly and behavioral tests are required before porting a formula to Rust.
